extracted.intended_audience: editors, typesetters, designers, and publishers (esp. University/press production staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and conventions for editorial presentation and typographic setting of book material: capitalization, punctuation, hyphenation, citations, unit abbreviations, treatment of names, and selection/usage of typefaces and point sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Umlaut: indexing of German names beginning with
rubrics_metrics.description: Umlaut, indexing of German names beginning with, 240.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indexing rule for German names that begin with an umlaut appears at page/reference 240 (see manual for specifics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of quotation marks for unusual word or phrase
rubrics_metrics.description: Unusual word or phrase, use of quotation marks for, 77.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place quotation marks around words or phrases considered unusual; see rule/reference 77 for examples and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of prefix 'Van' in names
rubrics_metrics.description: “Van,” rule for treatment of, 3, 340.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to alphabetize and capitalize names beginning with 'Van' is given at references 3 and 340.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of prefix 'Von' in names
rubrics_metrics.description: “Von,” rule for treatment of, 3, 340.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to alphabetize and capitalize names beginning with 'Von' is given at references 3 and 340.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of verbs in titles of publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Verbs: capitalization d, in titles of publications, 41.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies whether and how verbs are capitalized in publication titles; see rule/reference 41 for the exact convention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of verbs derived from proper names
rubrics_metrics.description: Verbs: derived from proper names, how to treat, 53.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rule for handling verbs that derive from proper names (e.g., capitalization, form); see reference 53.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letter affixed to verse or page numbers to denote fractional part
rubrics_metrics.description: Verse or page, letter affixed to number of, to denote fractional part: to be set in italic, 66; spacing of, 66.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters appended to numbers indicating fractional parts should be set in italic and have specified spacing; see reference 66.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versions of Bible: abbreviations and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Versions of Bible: abbreviations for, 109; capitalization of, 30.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives standardized abbreviations for Bible versions and rules for their capitalization (see refs 109 and 30).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 'Versus (v.)' formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Versus (v.), 59.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formatting and abbreviation guidance for 'versus' (v.) provided at reference 59.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of 'Vice' prefixed to titles
rubrics_metrics.description: “Vice,” prefixed to titles, how to treat, 201.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for formatting and capitalizing 'Vice' when prefixed to titles (see ref 201).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the vocative 'O'
rubrics_metrics.description: Vocative, “O,” 117.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on usage and punctuation/formatting for the vocative 'O' at reference 117.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviations in literary references ('vol.', 'chap.', 'p.', etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Vol.,” “chap.,” “p.,” etc., in literary references: use of numerals with, 337; when omitted, 337.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies when to use abbreviations like 'vol.', 'chap.', 'p.' with numerals and when to omit them; see ref 337.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyphenation/division rules for vowels
rubrics_metrics.description: Vowel: divide on, whenever possible. 22^; single, forming separate syllable in middle of word, to be put in first line in dividing, 324.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for breaking words at vowels: divide when possible; single vowel forming its own syllable in the middle of a word should be placed on the first line when divided (see refs 22? and 324).

rubrics_metrics.name: Units of measurement: designation and abbreviation conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Units of measurement, abbreviations for, xxi; spelled with lower-case initial letter, 88-.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the standard abbreviations for units of measurement and states that such abbreviations are spelled with a lower-case initial letter; see index/ref pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric weights and measures: designation and spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Weights and measures, metric: how to designate, in; spacing of, 369.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how to designate metric measures and their spacing conventions (see ref 369).

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting of 'Whereas' in resolutions
rubrics_metrics.description: “Whereas,” in resolutions, use of cap and small caps for, 51.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In resolutions the word 'Whereas' is to be set in capitals and small caps as directed at ref 51.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance of wide spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Wide spacing, where to avoid, 365.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies contexts where wide spacing should be avoided; see ref 365 for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotation marks for defined or highlighted words/phrases
rubrics_metrics.description: Word or phrase: accompanied by its definition, to be quoted, 76; to which attention is directed, use of quotation marks for, 79.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Words accompanied by definitions should be enclosed in quotes; use quotation marks to draw attention to words/phrases per refs 76 and 79.

rubrics_metrics.name: List and treatment of hyphenated words; preferred spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Words: hyphenated, list of, 314; of more than one spelling, how to spell, 119.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a list of commonly hyphenated words and prescribes preferred spellings for words with multiple spellings (see refs 314 and 119).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of compounds with 'Work' and 'World'
rubrics_metrics.description: “Work,” compounds of, 186. “World,” compounds of, 193.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rules for forming and styling compounds that include 'work' or 'world' (see refs 186 and 193).

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting/treatment of titles of works of art
rubrics_metrics.description: Works of art, titles of, to be roman-quoted, 84.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles of works of art should be set roman and quoted (see ref 84 for examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization and italics in zoological terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Zoological terms: use of capitals in, 46; of italics, 71.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which zoological terms take capitals and which should be italicized; see refs 46 and 71.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typographical terms: explanations and definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Typographical terms, explanation of, 85-94.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manual provides definitions and explanations of typographical terms in the listed pages; consult for terminology and application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typographical unit: definition and monotype specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: Unit, typographical, explained, 351; on monotype machine, 359.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the typographical unit and gives monotype-machine-specific information at refs 351 and 359.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index to types: catalog of typefaces and ornaments
rubrics_metrics.description: Index to types (Modern, Old Style, Monotype, Cheltenham, Caslon, De Vinne, etc.) — lists pages for specimens and ornaments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a catalog/index of typefaces, ornaments, initials, and miscellaneous signs with specimen pages; use to choose appropriate face/styles (see index entries and specimen pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimens of types in use: point sizes, leaded vs solid
rubrics_metrics.description: SPECIMENS OF TYPES IN USE — shows multiple point sizes (e.g., eleven point, eight point, six point) and forms (Solid, Leaded) for Modern, Old Style, Monotype, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manual supplies specimen settings demonstrating how different typefaces render at various point sizes and with leaded (spaced) vs solid setting; use these specimens to judge legibility, color, and emphasis for body text and display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of different point sizes/leadings for emphasis and readability
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimen pages show display lines with ALL CAPS, italics, leaded vs solid, and different point sizes to illustrate emphasis and readability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose point size, leading, and lettercase (e.g., small caps, ALL CAPS, italics) according to specimen guidance to achieve intended emphasis and maintain readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: University name and organizational terms: capitalization in official contexts
rubrics_metrics.description: University of Chicago: capitalization of special terms dealing with organization, administration, and curricula of, 40; titles of divisions, departments, officers, and courses and units of study, in official work dealing with, 49.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capitalize organizational and curricular terms in official University of Chicago documents per refs 40 and 49; guidance may be press-specific but illustrates principle for institutional style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of numerals and sample numeric strings in specimens
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens include numeric sequences (e.g., 1234567890) and illustrate how numbers set in different faces/sizes/leadings appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect specimen numeric settings to ensure number legibility and spacing; follow specimen conventions for numeric typography in running text and display.
